knowledge:
- key_parameters: Y=vector or matrix of gene-specific contrast estimates (e.g., log2 fold changes) ;; SE=vector or matrix of standard errors corresponding to the contrast estimates Y ;; two.sided=logical indicating whether to perform a two-sided test (defaults to TRUE)
- alternatives: limma=preferred for complex experimental designs and general linear modeling using moderated t-statistics ;; multtest=preferred when non-parametric permutation-based testing is desired
- when_to_use: Appropriate for two-channel or single-channel microarray differential expression analysis when the distribution of true differences has heavier tails than a normal distribution.
- pitfalls: Providing raw intensity values instead of pre-computed contrast estimates (log-fold changes) and standard errors ;; failing to ensure that Y and SE are properly paired and of matching dimensions.

workflows.name: laplace_mixture_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Identify differentially expressed genes from microarray contrast estimates and standard errors using a Laplace mixture model.
input: estimates.csv (matrix or vector of gene-specific contrast estimates/log-fold changes)
standard_errors.csv (matrix or vector of corresponding standard errors)
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the empirical Bayes Laplace mixture model using lapmix.fit ;; 2. Calculate the posterior odds of differential expression using lap.odds
workflows.code:
fit <- lapmix.fit(Y, SE)
odds <- lap.odds(Y, SE, fit)
